'''Clown loaches''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found year-round in [[tropical]] [[water|freshwater]] [[river]]s and [[lake]]s, and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] clown loaches for their ''coloration''.
